task: Resolve AssignCommitteeDialog vertical cut-off, portal stacking containment bug, background button bleed-through, and toast notification z-index coverage
summary: Diagnosed and resolved two interrelated UI rendering anomalies when clicking 'Assign Committee': (1) The dialog was mounted inside DashboardLayout's .cms-route-enter container, which carried permanent transform and will-change properties, trapping fixed inset-0 within the main scroll area instead of the viewport. This left the right-hand notification action buttons ('Inspect Roster', 'Assign Committee', '✓', '🗑') and page header buttons exposed outside the dimmed backdrop as fragmented 'weird boxes'. Portaled AssignCommitteeDialog directly to document.body using createPortal with z-[100] and full-screen backdrop-blur-xs overlay. (2) Re-engineered the flexbox modal centering from unbounded items-center to a bounded scroll architecture (my-auto, max-h-[calc(100vh-2rem)], shrink-0 header and footer, overflow-y-auto CardContent). This permanently prevents the modal header and close button from getting cut off at the top of the viewport. (3) Added top-level z-index: 999999 to Sonner's [data-sonner-toaster] and App.jsx Toaster to guarantee toast notifications are never covered by modals. Added unit test suite for AssignCommitteeDialog and passed all 6 quality gates.
